| `content`    | `object`             |          | `\{\}`  | The list config: `{ register, schema, filter?, sort?, limit?, offset?, extend?, presentation?, variant?, lead?, title?, meta?, text?, label?, pill?, trailing?, icon?, rowRoute?, rowIdField?, headerLink?, headerNote?, emptyText?, errorText?, valueLabels?, endpointSource?, bar? }`. `bar` (`{ valueField, maxField?, overVariant? }`) draws a thin track under each row: filled to `valueField` against `maxField` (drawn in the error colour past it with `overVariant: "error"`), or without `maxField` against the largest row. `endpointSource` (`{ url, method?, params?, responsePath? }`) reads the rows from an app endpoint instead of `register` / `schema`. `valueLabels` maps a field's stored values to the labels the templates show. `headerNote` and `headerLink.label` fill `{total}` and `{count:&lt;field&gt;=&lt;value&gt;}`, the loaded rows with that value. A row that is a plain string or number (an endpoint answering `["…", "…"]`) is read as `{ value }`: templates reach it as `{value}`, and without `title` a row shows the value itself. `presentation: "notice"` draws the rows as sentences in one box toned by `variant` (`info`, `warning` or `error`), after an optional `lead` (`{total}` filled in). `dot` (a field, or `{ field, colorMap? }`) draws a colour dot before the title; `flags` (`[{ field, label, value? }]`) draws the labels of the flags a row has ("Start", "End") at its end. `footerAction` (`{ label, icon?, type, ..., disabledWhen?, disabledReason? }`) ends the card with one action, also under the empty text; while the visibleWhen condition `disabledWhen` holds the button is disabled and `disabledReason` shows under it. `groupBy` (a field path) draws the rows in groups under a heading per value, headed by the field's `valueLabels` entry; `groupOrder` (values) orders the groups and `groupEmptyLabel` heads the rows without a value. `density: "compact"` draws the rows 10px above and below, at least 56px tall, with the title at 500 (DqProcesanalyse). |
